description: Service account 'svc-deploy-prod' accessed the 'user-management-api' admin endpoint and then attempted to assume roles in the HR and Finance AWS accounts — resources entirely outside its ci-cd-deployer scope. The account has no IAM policy granting cross-account assume-role. Three consecutive AccessDenied events followed by one successful AssumeRole.

context.note: lateral movement pattern: ci-cd account trying to pivot to HR and Finance
